messages:
elaine: Final logistics for Wednesday's 'Model Ops Webinar' at 11am PT. Quick checklist: reg page fields, Zoom vs livestream, recording export, replay gating, HubSpot routing. Preview: https://rwd.ai/events/model-ops-demo
nate: Recommend Zoom Webinar + unlisted YouTube mirror. Zoom for analytics and Q&A; YT for reach.
cam: Reg page: add hidden utm_campaign=model-ops-2026 and utm_medium=webinar. Add optional 'brief use case' textbox. CTA test: 'Reserve my spot' vs 'Get replay' (split).
elaine: good. Replay policy? full replay gated to registrants for 72 hours then public. Short 90s clip for socials within 8 hours.
ops-bot: Post-record workflow queued: export speaker-view mp4 -> copy to gs://redwood-recordings/model-ops-2026/ -> tag transcript:auto -> create clip task in #content-prod.
nate: Lead routing: registrant -> HubSpot contact; attendee -> set property webinar_attended=true; high-engagement (watch_pct>60 or asked_q=true) -> add to SDR queue. Prefer direct webhook to ingestion lambda.
cam: webhook payload schema: email(required), utm_campaign, utm_medium, company_size, use_case, attended, watch_pct, asked_q. We'll map fields into HubSpot.
elaine: confirmation email should include calendar add, replay expectations, transcript link later, and CTA to request a custom benchmark. Keep tone short.
ops-bot: Zoom webinar created, panelists invited. Reminder emails configured (24h, 1h, 10m). Rehearsal today 4:30pm PT.
elaine: Action items: @cam enable hidden utm and optional fields; @nate confirm webhook deploy by EOD or fallback to Zapier; @ops-bot run export + clip. I'll post final checklist in #marketing-ops.
nate: webhook deployed to staging, testing now.
cam: reg page updated on staging. enabling A/B split at 6pm PT.
elaine: thanks all  see rehearsal. :raised_hands:
